text:
maria: Heads up — noticed weird assignment totals on the A/B rollout dashboard for rollout_id=exp_129. Dashboard shows ~62% treatment but our assignment API and logs show ~38% treatment. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/snap/exp_129.png

samir: Is that prod or staging? can you share a few example user_ids and the assignment API response?

maria: Prod. Example user_ids: user_2048, user_3042. API response for user_2048: ```{
  "user_id": "user_2048",
  "rollouts": [{
    "rollout_id": "exp_129",
    "variant": "control"
  }]
}``` Dashboard shows that same bucket counted under "treatment" in the cohort table.

qa_tim: I ran a quick aggregate in staging to compare assignment ledger vs dashboard counts. Query: ```SELECT variant, count(*) FROM assignment_ledger WHERE rollout_id='exp_129' GROUP BY variant;``` ledger: control=620, treatment=380. Dashboard aggregates (same time window) show control=380, treatment=620.

eli: That smells like a mapping inversion between variant_label and variant_key when we ingest exposure events. Any recent releases to the analytics pipeline or dashboard service? rollout config changed?

maria: No config changes pushed by product recently. I can confirm rollout metadata still lists variants as [control,treatment] and keys as [A,B].

jess: Customer impact? are counts just visual or does this affect routing/serving?

maria: Visual only AFAICT — assignment API and serving are returning the correct variant per user. Two customers opened support tickets complaining console shows them in the other bucket though.

support-bot: Created incident INC-2345 and linked this thread. Priority: P2.

samir: Ok. quick mitigation options: 1) revert last dashboard deploy (candidate) 2) patch the ingestion mapper to fallback to variant_key when label->key mapping ambiguous 3) run targeted backfill to recompute todays aggregates. Which do we want first?

eli: I pulled the mapping table: `select variant_key, label from rollout_variant_map where rollout_id='exp_129';` result shows: A -> "treatment", B -> "control". That is inverted compared to rollout metadata. So ingestion is using that table incorrectly (or the table got swapped during a migration).

qa_tim: Repro steps I used: 1) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood/infer/assign?user_id=user_2048&rollout_id=exp_129 2) note variant in JSON 3) open console rollout view (team -> experiments -> exp_129) 4) compare cohort counts. I attached console console-screencap.mp4 to the ticket.

maria: Please escalate, customers are watching this dashboard for go/no-go on a launch. We need rollback or hotfix ASAP.

samir: I'll schedule a rollback of the dashboard service to v2.14 in ~30m and trigger backfill of today's aggregates after rollback. Can eng-platform confirm no dependent schema changes?

eli: Confirmed: a migration that ran last night accidentally swapped label assignment in rollout_variant_map for 3 rollouts including exp_129. I'll revert the migration and push a hotfix to the mapper service to prefer rollout metadata over the mapping table until we reconcile.

jess: Thanks — please ping me once dashboard shows correct totals. Also add postmortem and customer comms draft to INC-2345.

samir: Recap/action items: rollback dashboard in 30m (samir), revert migration + hotfix mapper (eli), run backfill for exp_129 aggregates (qa_tim), create postmortem + comms (jess). ETA for visible fix: ~2-3 hours.

maria: Thanks team. Marking as urgent and following up with the two customers. :pray:
